title: Buttons
description: Buttons in the Taskscape desktop task-manager app: title-bar icon toggles, project switcher, footer and grid bulk actions, inspector and rich-text editor buttons, sheet and dialog buttons, toast, trash, settings and capture-bar controls, plus key-actions, including the click-activated shortcut recorder. Built from the 95 row objects of rows-buttons.json (kinds: button, toolbar-button, key-action; no row uses kind link). The source count of 96 could not be reconciled with the file, so a row may be missing between rows 37 and 52 and is not catalogued here.

title: Menus
